R3 — The post-flow guidance now contains an explicit gate requiring finalize-cleanup success, `active:false` status from `sdd-forge flow get status`, and `workflow.flowIntegration` set to `enable`, and tests assert this requirement.

R4 — The updated `src/skills/sdd-forge.flow/SKILL.md` now directs reading `.sdd-forge/last-finalized-spec` from the main repo and running `sdd-forge workflow issue-log-import --spec <lastFinalizedSpec>` there, and this is explicitly asserted in the added spec test.

R5 — `src/skills/sdd-forge.flow/SKILL.md` now includes post-flow guidance to run only `data.candidates` from one import call, screen each displayed candidate (target/problem/cause or evidence/improvement direction/board reason), and call `workflow add` only for user-approved candidates, matching the R5 requirement.

R6 — `src/skills/sdd-forge.flow/SKILL.md` now states that issue-log-import/workflow add failures are post-processing failures after flow completion and must be reported without changing the flow completion state, matching R6 wording and intent.

R7 — Both generated artifacts include the new post-flow board integration guidance text, and the diff adds/keeps source-to-generated alignment via the new spec-local check for both .agents and .claude files.
